policy: Main-murti, festival, kavacha, symbolic and conjectural forms must be distinguished. Unknown anatomy stays unknown. Right/left means the deity's own side unless stated otherwise.

deities.associated: Kalvar Perumal, Varahi, Lakshmi and Ganapati are separate worship locations.
